# ZenRows

The `@mastra/zenrows` package exposes [ZenRows](https://www.zenrows.com) Fetch and Extract as Mastra-compatible tools. ZenRows handles proxies, JavaScript rendering and anti-bot protection. The tools can read pages that block typical scrapers. Each factory returns a tool created with [`createTool()`](/reference/tools/create-tool) and a typed Zod input and output schema.

The scrape tool returns a page's content. The extract tool returns the structured fields ZenRows parsed out of a page, such as a product's name and price, with no selectors to write.

## Installation

```bash npm2yarn
npm install @mastra/zenrows zod
```

Set `ZENROWS_API_KEY` in your environment. You can also pass an API key directly to any factory.

## Quick start

Use `createZenrowsTools()` to create both tools with shared configuration:

```typescript title="src/mastra/tools/index.ts"
import { createZenrowsTools } from '@mastra/zenrows'

export const zenrowsTools = createZenrowsTools()
// Or pass an explicit API key:
// export const zenrowsTools = createZenrowsTools({ apiKey: 'your-zenrows-api-key' })
```

The returned object contains `zenrowsScrape` and `zenrowsExtract`.

Create either tool separately when an agent doesn't need both:

```typescript title="src/mastra/tools/index.ts"
import { createZenrowsExtractTool, createZenrowsScrapeTool } from '@mastra/zenrows'

export const scrapeTool = createZenrowsScrapeTool()
export const extractTool = createZenrowsExtractTool({ apiKey: 'your-zenrows-api-key' })
```

A tool reads the API key when it executes, not when you create it. A missing key fails at execution time with a configuration error.

## Configuration

All factories accept `ZenrowsClientOptions`:

<PropertiesTable
  content={[
  {
    name: 'apiKey',
    type: 'string',
    description: 'ZenRows API key. Falls back to the `ZENROWS_API_KEY` environment variable.',
    isOptional: true,
  },
  {
    name: 'baseUrl',
    type: 'string',
    description:
      'Override the ZenRows API base URL. Falls back to the `ZENROWS_API_URL` environment variable, then `https://api.zenrows.com/v1`.',
    isOptional: true,
  },
  {
    name: 'timeout',
    type: 'number',
    description:
      'Timeout in milliseconds for one request. ZenRows can take up to 3 minutes on a hard page, and a request cut short on your side can still be charged.',
    isOptional: true,
    defaultValue: '180000',
  },
  {
    name: 'fetch',
    type: 'typeof fetch',
    description: 'Custom `fetch` implementation.',
    isOptional: true,
  },
]}
/>

A request ZenRows rejects throws a `ZenrowsError` that carries the HTTP `status`, the API error `code` (for example `REQS004` or `REQS007`), its `reason` when it has one, and the API's `detail`. Its message tells the agent what the error means.

## Credits

ZenRows charges 1 credit for a basic request, 5 with JavaScript rendering, 10 with premium proxies and 25 with both, the same on every plan. Both tools return the credits a request used as `credits`, read from the `X-Request-Credits` response header, or `null` when the response doesn't carry it. `mode: 'auto'` turns on Adaptive Stealth Mode. Adaptive Stealth Mode starts from the cheapest configuration that can work and escalates to JavaScript rendering or Premium Proxies only when the page needs them, and only the configuration that succeeds is charged.

## `createZenrowsScrapeTool()`

Creates the `zenrows-scrape` tool. Scrape fetches one URL and returns its content as Markdown by default, as plaintext, or as the page's HTML. With `css_extractor`, it returns only the fields the selectors name, as JSON text.

```typescript
import { createZenrowsScrapeTool } from '@mastra/zenrows'

const scrapeTool = createZenrowsScrapeTool()
```

### Scrape input

<PropertiesTable
  content={[
  { name: 'url', type: 'string', description: 'The page to fetch. Only `http` and `https` URLs are accepted.' },
  {
    name: 'response_type',

    description: 'What to return. `html` returns the page as ZenRows received it.',
    isOptional: true,
    defaultValue: "'markdown'",

    description: 'Adaptive Stealth Mode. Use it instead of `js_render` and `premium_proxy`, not with them.',
    isOptional: true,

  { name: 'js_render', type: 'boolean', description: 'Render the page in a headless browser first.', isOptional: true },
  {

  {

  {

    isOptional: true,

    name: 'block_resources',
    type: 'string',
    description: 'Comma-separated resource types to block, such as `image,media,font`.',

<PropertiesTable
  content={[

## `createZenrowsExtractTool()`

Creates the `zenrows-extract` tool. Extract returns the fields of a page as JSON, named the way the site names them. It works on any domain ZenRows has prepared. A domain that isn't prepared yet, or a page Extract doesn't recognise, throws a `ZenrowsError` with code `REQS007` and isn't charged.

```typescript
import { createZenrowsExtractTool } from '@mastra/zenrows'

const extractTool = createZenrowsExtractTool()
```

### Extract input

<PropertiesTable
  content={[
  { name: 'url', type: 'string', description: 'The page to extract. Only `http` and `https` URLs are accepted.' },
  {
    name: 'extract_fields',
    type: 'string',
    description:
      'Comma-separated fields to return, dot-notated inside a group, such as `products.name,products.price`. Omit it to receive every field.',
    isOptional: true,
  },
  {
    name: 'mode',
    type: "'auto'",
    description: 'Adaptive Stealth Mode. Use it instead of `js_render` and `premium_proxy`, not with them.',
    isOptional: true,
  },
  { name: 'js_render', type: 'boolean', description: 'Render the page in a headless browser first.', isOptional: true },
  {
    name: 'premium_proxy',
    type: 'boolean',
    description: 'Route the request through residential IPs.',
    isOptional: true,
  },
  {
    name: 'proxy_country',
    type: 'string',
    description: 'Two-letter country code for the exit IP. Needs `premium_proxy` or `mode`.',
    isOptional: true,
  },
]}
/>

### Extract output

<PropertiesTable
  content={[
  { name: 'url', type: 'string', description: 'The input URL.' },
  { name: 'data', type: 'unknown', description: 'The extracted fields, parsed from JSON.' },
  {
    name: 'credits',
    type: 'number | null',
    description: 'Credits the request used. Extract adds no credits on top of the request it runs.',
  },
]}
/>

## Use the tools with an agent

```typescript title="src/mastra/agents/research-agent.ts"
import { Agent } from '@mastra/core/agent'
import { createZenrowsTools } from '@mastra/zenrows'

export const researchAgent = new Agent({
  id: 'research-agent',
  name: 'Research Agent',
  model: '__GATEWAY_ANTHROPIC_MODEL_SONNET__',
  instructions:
    'Read pages with the scrape tool. When you need the fields of a product, article or listing page, use the extract tool.',
  tools: createZenrowsTools(),
})
```

## Environment variables

| Variable | Description |
| - | - |
| `ZENROWS_API_KEY` | Your ZenRows API key. Used when `apiKey` isn't passed to a factory function. |
| `ZENROWS_API_URL` | Optional. Overrides the API base URL when `baseUrl` isn't passed. |
